business_summary.text: Bodal Chemicals is an integrated chemical manufacturer with products in Basic Chemicals, Dye Intermediates, Dyestuffs, and Chlor Alkali segments. The company has a global presence with manufacturing facilities in India and subsidiaries in Turkey, China, and Indonesia.

lab.quote: During the year, this growth was lead by Improved volumes, better realizations and recognition of SGST incentive from Govt. of Punjab for our unit 12 located in Punjab.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Growth in FY26 was led by improved volumes, better realizations, and recognition of SGST incentive from the Government of Punjab for Unit 12 located in Punjab.

lab.quote: During the year, the increased overhead from the Saykha plant is partially offsetting the profitability of other divisions.

call_memory.statement: Increased overhead from the Saykha plant partially offset the profitability of other divisions during FY26.

lab.quote: In basic chemicals revenue is increased due to rise in raw material price, i.e Sulphur, followed by an increase in finished goods prices.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Basic chemicals revenue increased due to a rise in raw material prices, particularly Sulphur, followed by an increase in finished goods prices.

lab.quote: However, margins remain under pressure due to intense competition, subdued demand and the sharp rise in raw material prices.

call_memory.statement: Saykha Benzene downstream margins remain under pressure due to intense competition, subdued demand, and a sharp rise in raw material prices.

lab.quote: We expect gradual growth and meaningful contributions to both the top and bottom lines on a QoQ basis.

call_memory.statement: The company expects gradual growth and meaningful contributions to both the top and bottom lines from Saykha Benzene downstream products on a QoQ basis.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Turkish subsidiary Sener Boya was impacted by hyperinflation, causing a Rs 26.5 mn loss in Q4FY26 under AS 29.

call_memory.statement: Approximately 40% of Basic Chemicals output is captively consumed by Dye Intermediates, and approximately 40% of Dye Intermediates output is captively consumed by Dyestuffs.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bodal estimates it holds approximately 13% domestic and 3% global market share in Dyestuff, and approximately 20% domestic and 6% global market share in Dye-Intermediates.

call_points.text: Saykha Benzene downstream achieved satisfactory production in Q4FY26; management expects gradual QoQ contributions despite margin pressure.
Increased overhead from the Saykha plant partially offset the profitability of other operational divisions during FY26.
Basic Chemicals FY26 revenue rose 80% driven by raw material sulphur price increases passed into finished goods prices.
Rationalisation and monetisation of non-core assets helped maintain operating cash flow and company profitability.
Management expects passing increased raw material costs into finished goods to help enhance margins in the near term.
Chlor Alkali business reported revenue of ₹338.7 Cr for FY26, remaining stable YoY.

timeline.summary: Bodal Chemicals released its Q4/FY26 investor presentation highlighting Saykha plant ramp-up and non-core asset monetisation.
Suresh J. Patel, on behalf of Bodal Chemicals Ltd’s promoters, declared no encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 on 04-04-2026.
Bodal Chemicals reported Q1FY27 results with 56% YoY revenue growth to ₹715 Cr and 219% YoY PAT growth to ₹30.4 Cr, driven by strong demand and price realisation across divisions.
